_: Waylight theme example. Copy to ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/waylight/theme.json or /etc/waylight/theme.json. The greeter reads the first readable file once at startup; a missing or broken file can never prevent sign-in. Keys beginning with '_' are unknown keys and are ignored.
_rules: Every value is validated fail-open: unknown keys are ignored, a wrong-typed value falls back to that key's default, colors must be #rgb/#rgba/#rrggbb/#aarrggbb, ratios clamp to 0-0.9, sizes clamp to 1-2000 px, and font.scale clamps to 0.5-2.0.
_preset: dusk (stock look), midnight (near-black blues, dimmer fills), or daylight (light frosted gradient with dark text). The preset applies first; the explicit keys below override it.

colors._overlayTop: Translucent overlay above the background, drawn top to bottom with overlayBottom.
colors._textSecondary: Status messages and focused power-button borders.
colors._textCombo: Session picker text (closed control and its popup).
colors._accent: Focus borders on the session picker, username and response fields.
colors._fillHover: Hovered session option/tile and the response field background.
colors._fillRest: Session picker, username field and selected-tile background.
colors._fillSubtle: Arrow button rest background and hovered power buttons.
colors._avatarFallback: Avatar circle behind portraits and the silhouette.
colors._avatarGlyph: Silhouette drawn when a tile has no picture.

background._mode: builtin (embedded background.svg), image (local file drawn PreserveAspectCrop), solid (color), or gradient (top to bottom).
background._image: Local file path used when mode is image. An unreadable image shows the window color behind the themed overlay.
background._color: Used when mode is solid; defaults to the window color.
background._top_bottom: Used when mode is gradient (top to bottom); both default to the window color.

font._scale: Multiplies every font size and the clock cap; clamped to 0.5-2.0.

layout._clockTopRatio: Clock column top as a fraction of window height (0-0.9).
layout._clockTimeCap: Upper bound (px, before font scale) for the clock time size.
layout._panelTopRatioShort: Used when the window is shorter than panelShortHeight.
layout._fieldWidth: Username entry/label width; the response field keeps its own narrower width.
layout._fieldHeight: Also sizes the two arrow buttons.
layout._barMarginLeft_right: Top bar margins for the corner label and the session picker.
